svg.title: Oracle Forms Migration Fleet development architecture on Azure
svg.desc: Operators authenticate to an Azure Container Apps workbench that calls Microsoft Foundry using managed identity. The source replica connects to an internal Oracle demo database. The migrated React and Spring application connects passwordlessly to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. GitHub Actions builds images in Azure Container Registry and telemetry flows to Application Insights and Log Analytics.
svg.text: Microsoft Foundry workbench · source workflow replica · migrated React/Java application · PostgreSQL target
workbench traces · Container Apps platform logs
Solid arrows: application or deployment traffic. Dashed purple arrows: Microsoft Entra managed identity. Dashed blue arrows: telemetry.
The source surface is a workflow replica, not Oracle Forms runtime. Supporting Blob Storage, Key Vault, and Azure SQL resources remain preview-only and are not shown as active.
